events.text: Ottoman state conquered the territory, becoming an Ottoman protectorate.

evidence.quote: In 1484 , the Ottoman state conquered the territory

events.text: Territory came under direct Ottoman rule.
Sultan Selim II settled Izmail with his Nogai subjects.

evidence.quote: In 1569 Sultan Selim II settled Izmail with his Nogai subjects

events.label: capture
events.text: Russian general Nicholas Repnin took the fortress of Izmail.

evidence.quote: After Russian general Nicholas Repnin took the fortress of Izmail in 1770

events.label: siege
events.text: Alexander Suvorov successfully stormed the fortress of Izmail.

evidence.quote: the Russian Army commander Alexander Suvorov successfully stormed it on 22 December 1790

events.text: Izmail returned to the Ottoman Empire at the end of the war.

evidence.quote: At the end of the war , Izmail was returned to the Ottoman Empire

events.label: capture
events.text: Russian forces took Izmail for the third time.

evidence.quote: Russian forces took it for the third time on 14 September 1809

events.text: Izmail ceded to Russia with Bessarabia by Treaty of Bucharest.

evidence.quote: After it was ceded to Russia with the rest of Bessarabia by the 1812 Treaty of Bucharest

events.text: Russia regained control of Izmail after the Russo-Turkish War.

evidence.quote: Russia gained control of Izmail again after the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–1878

events.label: occupation
events.text: Romanian Army occupied the city after a skirmish.

evidence.quote: the city was occupied by the Romanian Army on 22 January 1918

events.label: occupation
events.text: Soviet Red Army occupied the town.

evidence.quote: In 1940 , and again during World War II , it was occupied by the Soviet Red Army

events.text: Izmail Oblast formed; the town became its administrative center.

evidence.quote: Izmail Oblast was formed in 1940 and the town remained its administrative center

events.text: Town included in the Ukrainian SSR.

evidence.quote: included ( August 1940 ) in the Ukrainian SSR

events.label: occupation
events.text: Romanian Army began occupying the region during Operation Barbarossa.

events.label: occupation

evidence.quote: the region was occupied in 1941–1944 by the Romanian Army

events.text: Oblast merged into Odessa Oblast; town lost administrative center role.

events.text: Izmail became part of independent Ukraine.
